title: Chapel + Main
specs: Focus on local, fresh ingredients for food and beer
Private events and parties held on occasion; contact via phone or website form to arrange
blurb: Chapel + Main is a community-focused restaurant and brewery in Dover, New Hampshire. They source fresh, local ingredients to create inspired comfort food and craft unique beers. Guests can enjoy a welcoming atmosphere with a dining room, patio, and bar.
extraNote: No mask policy; masks optional · Reservations not required; dining room can fill up quickly especially weekends in winter; patio and bar first come, first served · Service animals always welcome; other pets allowed on patio weather permitting · Restaurant, patio and bathrooms are ADA compliant
